:::{#thm-rr-switch-ref}

#### Switching the reference group in a risk ratio

For nonzero probabilities $\pi_1$ and $\pi_2$,
the [risk ratio](#def-RR) with the reference group switched is the reciprocal of the original:

$$\rho(\pi_2,\pi_1) = \inv{\rho(\pi_1,\pi_2)}$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-change-ref-group, worked in @sol-change-ref-group.

:::
